title: Ashbury Rewards Top-Tier Breakfast Values: The Per-Person Breakfast Credit
content:
The per-person breakfast credit of an Ashbury Rewards member's elite breakfast credit on Guest Folios depends on the tier the member holds.

**Rule.** Per-person breakfast credit: for an Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite member the per-person breakfast credit is the brand's elite breakfast credit per person multiplied by the Ambassador breakfast scale of 1.3 and rounded half up to the cent; for an Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite member it is the brand's elite breakfast credit per person plus the Titanium breakfast supplement of $10.00. A member of any other tier receives no such tier value: the per-person breakfast credit is the brand's elite breakfast credit per person as it stands.

The tier is the tier shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay.

## Rate card

| Ashbury Rewards tier held | Per-person breakfast credit | Rounding |
|---|---|---|
| Ambassador Elite | The brand's elite breakfast credit per person multiplied by 1.3 | Half up to the cent, on the scaled figure |
| Titanium Elite | The brand's elite breakfast credit per person plus $10.00 | None needed |
| Any other tier | The brand's elite breakfast credit per person as it stands | — |

## Worked values (hypothetical brand credit per person)

| Hypothetical brand credit per person | Ambassador Elite | Titanium Elite |
|---|---|---|
| $30.00 | $39.00 ($30.00 multiplied by 1.3) | $40.00 ($30.00 plus $10.00) |
| $33.15 | $43.10 ($33.15 multiplied by 1.3 is $43.095, rounded half up) | $43.15 |

The scale acts on the brand's credit per person alone; the Titanium supplement is a fixed $10.00 added to it.
